ideas.title: Minnesota's Growing Fraud Problem
ideas.description: Investigate the recent surge in fraud cases in Minnesota, including the $2M bail set for a former Penn State student.
ideas.angle: Exploring the causes and consequences of Minnesota's growing fraud problem
questions: What are the underlying causes of Minnesota's growing fraud problem?
How are law enforcement agencies responding to the surge in fraud cases?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the recent surge in fraud cases in Minnesota, including the $2M bail set for a former Penn State student, and examine the causes and consequences of this growing problem.
